Catch every goal from Matchweek 3 & 4 of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27 season, featuring East Bengal FC's five-goal show, Punjab FC's stoppage-time winner, Sporting Club Delhi's late comeback against Mumbai City FC and plenty more.
From long-range strikes and clinical finishes to last-gasp goals that changed the game, relive all the action from across the MG ISL.
